sheets.prompt: Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: an ancient temple at the very bottom of a station inside a sun, a great dark sphere of smooth indigo stone hanging below the station on three long chains, its one great round window like an eye turned straight down into the blinding white-gold surface of the sun; a narrow stair of white stone winds down to it around the chains between slow arches of rose and saffron plasma; inside the round window rows of empty glass lamps hang in rings, a few of them lit with a soft jade-green light; the glyph of three dots over an upward arc is carved large above the door; a long white veil of woven shade-cloth hangs from the sphere and ripples in the heat. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, blinding white-gold, saffron, apricot and rose-magenta plasma, deep indigo and violet shadows, a touch of jade, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
